author: sonnet
label: seeded-01-01
changes: Reordered into newcomer layout: summary and how the system works today, then terms, then the diagram, then steps, notes, failure table and open questions.
Replaced the terse note list with three numbered steps, each giving what starts it, what it does, where its data lives, and the reply or failure behaviour.
Merged the scattered notes (hashed tokens, 30 minutes and once, generic response, rate limit, password policy) into the steps and one short notes list instead of repeating them.
Cut the vague note 'the email worker has the usual retries' and replaced it with the concrete existing behaviour (3 retries, then dropped, nobody notified) in the failure table.
Defined the single new table reset_tokens and made the hourly rate limit a count of its rows, so no extra counter mechanism is needed.
Added the one-step flow detail that issuing a link marks earlier live links dead, and that the token is checked again on submit.
Added a failure table and an open-questions section for the silently dropped email.
Kept the ASCII diagram in its fenced block with the summary and terms before it and notes after it.
